full contents\nfn parse_git_log_snapshots(\n    workspace: &Path,\n    jsonl_path: &Path,\n) -> Result<Vec<JsonlSnapshot>> {\n    let relative_path = Worker performance tracking and velocity-aware claim scoring.\n//!\n//! This module tracks how long workers take to complete beads based on their\n//! (model, harness, issue_type) configuration and uses this data to inform\n//! claim scoring.\n//!\n//! ## Data Flow\n//!\n//! 1. When a bead is claimed, `worker_sessions` row is created (in claim.rs)\n//! 2. When a bead is closed, the session is updated with `closed_at` and `duration_seconds`\n//! 3. Claim scoring uses expected_seconds from velocity_stats: score = impact / expected_seconds\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse rusqlite::{params, Connection};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n\n/// Velocity statistics for a (model, harness, issue_type) tuple.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct VelocityStats {\n    pub model: String,\n    pub harness: String,\n    pub issue_type: String,\n    pub sample_count: i64,\n    pub p50_seconds: Option<i64>,\n    pub p90_seconds: Option<i64>,\n    pub avg_seconds: Option<f64>,\n    pub last_updated: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Worker session record from worker_sessions table.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct WorkerSession {\n    pub worker_id: String,\n    pub model: Option<String>,\n    pub harness: Option<String>,\n    pub harness_version: Option<String>,\n    pub claimed_at: String,\n    pub bead_id: Option<String>,\n    pub workspace_path: String,\n    pub closed_at: Option<String>,\n    pub duration_seconds: Option<i64>,\n}\n\n/// Update a worker session with close time and duration.\n///\n/// Called when a bead is closed. Finds the most recent claim session for the bead\n/// and updates it with closed_at and duration_seconds.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `tx` - The transaction to use\n/// * `bead_id` - The bead that was closed\n/// * `closed_at` - When the bead was closed\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(true)` if a session was found and updated\n/// * `Ok(false)` if no matching session was found\npub fn update_session_on_close(\n    tx: &Connection,\n    bead_id: &str,\n    closed_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n) -> Result<bool> {\n    // Find the most recent session for this bead\n    let (claimed_at_str, model, harness, issue_type): (String, Option<String>, Option<String>, Option<String>) =\n        match tx.query_row(\n            \"SELECT ws.claimed_at, ws.model, ws.harness, i.issue_type\n             FROM worker_sessions ws\n             INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = ws.bead_id\n             WHERE ws.bead_id = ?1\n             ORDER BY ws.claimed_at DESC\n             LIMIT 1\",\n            params![bead_id],\n            |row| {\n                let claimed_at: String = row.get(0)?;\n                let model: Option<String> = row.get(1)?;\n                let harness: Option<String> = row.get(2)?;\n                let issue_type: Option<String> = row.get(3)?;\n                Ok((claimed_at, model, harness, issue_type))\n            },\n        ) {\n            Ok(data) => data,\n            Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => return Ok(false),\n            Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n        };\n\n    // Parse claimed_at and calculate duration\n    let claimed_at = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&claimed_at_str)\n        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Invalid claimed_at format: {}\", e))?\n        .with_timezone(&Utc);\n\n    let duration_seconds =    SET closed_at = ?1, duration_seconds = ?2\n         WHERE bead_id = ?3 AND claimed_at = ?4\",\n        params![\n            closed_at.to_rfc3339(),\n            duration_seconds,\n recompute_velocity_stats(\n    tx: &Connection,\n    model: &str,\n    harness: &str,\n    issue_type: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Get last 50 completed sessions for this tuple\n    let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n        \"SELECT duration_seconds\n         FROM worker_sessions ws\n         INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = ws.bead_id\n         WHERE ws.model = ?1\n           AND ws.harness = ?2\n .query_map(params![model, harness, issue_type], |row| row.get(0))?\n        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n    let sample_count = durations.len() as i64;\n    let (p50_seconds, p90_seconds, avg_seconds) = if durations.is_empty() {\n        (None, None, None)\n    } else {\n        durations.sort_unstable();\n        let len = durations.len();\n\n        // Calculate len > 1 { Some(durations[p90_idx]) } else { p50 };\n\n        // Calculate average\n        let sum: i64 = durations.iter().sum();\n        let avg = Some(sum as f64 / len as f64);\n\n        (p50, type_: Option<String>,\n787\t    assignee: Option<String>,\n788\t    priority: Option<i32>,\n789\t    limit: Option<usize>,\n790\t    all: bool,\n791\t    format: &str,\n792\t) -> Result<()> {\n793\t    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n794\t    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n795\t    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n796\t\n797\t    let mut issues = if all IssueFilter::default();\n803\t        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n804\t            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n805\t        }\n806\t        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n807\t            filter.issue_type = Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n808\t        }\n809\t        filter.assignee = if snapshots.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(0);\n    }\n\n    let mut events_created = 0;\n\n    // Process snapshots chronologically (oldest to newest)\n    for window in snapshots.windows(2) {\n        let prev = &window[0];\n        let curr = &window[1];\n\n        // Find differences between snapshots and create synthetic events\n        for (issue_id, current_issue) in &curr.issues {\n            let prev_issue = prev.issues.get(issue_id);\n\n            match prev_issue {\n                None => {\n                    // New bead appeared - create synthetic created event\n issue_id,\n                            EventType::StatusChanged,\n                            Some(Status::Open.as_str()),\n                            Some(Status::InProgress.as_str()),\n issue_id,\n                            EventType::Closed,\n                            None,\n                            current_issue.close_reason.as_deref(),\n                            current_issue.closed_at.unwrap_or(current_issue.created_at),\n                        )?;\n                        events_created += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n                Some(previous_issue) => {\n                    // Existing bead - check for status changes\n                    if previous_issue.status != current_issue.status {\n                        match                           // any -> closed = closed event\n                                insert_synthetic_event(\n                                    storage,\n                      curr.commit_date,\n                                )?;\n                                events_created += 1;\n                            }\n                            _ => {\n jsonl_path.strip_prefix(workspace).unwrap_or(jsonl_path);\n    let path_str = relative_path.to_str().unwrap_or(\".beads/issues.jsonl\");\n\n    // First, get list of commits that touched this file\n .current_dir(workspace)\n        .output()?;\n\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        // Not in git repo or file has no history - return empty\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n\n    let   let issues = match file_output {\n            Ok(out) if out.status.success() => {\n                let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);\n                parse_jsonl_issues(&content)?\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // File didn't exist at this commit (or was empty)\n                HashMap::new()\n            }\n        };\n\n        snapshots.push(JsonlSnapshot {\n            commit_hash,\n            commit_date,\n            issues,\n        });\n    }\n\n    // git log returns newest first, we want oldest first\n    snapshots.reverse();\n    Ok(snapshots)\n}\n\n/// Parse git date format \"2024-01-01 12:00:00 +0000\" to DateTime<Utc>\nfn parse_git_date(date_str: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    use
